content: spaCy zh_core_web_trf ~500MB, requires CUDA-friendly environment. zh_core_web_sm/md/lg smaller. Person name NER on OntoNotes Chinese ~85-92 F1 (model-dependent). Heavy binary dependency, conflicts with local-first / no-cloud constraint, and jieba + custom dict already cover PrivacyGuard's name recognition needs for v39. NOT recommended for v39.
